aria: Animated recap of the Lakers' 121 to 116 road win at Detroit: Austin Reaves' off-balance three with 46 seconds left, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 43 points, the top scorers, how the Lakers won, and the next game at Atlanta.
notes: Box score from the Lakers' 121–116 win over the Detroit Pistons in Detroit on Nov 8, 2026, from the Covers.com box score, with game details from the AP (via Yahoo Sports), The Sporting Tribune, theScore, USA Today (via Yahoo Sports), IBTimes Australia and Lakers Daily. All 121 Lakers points and all 116 Pistons points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals. The 26-point lead (40–14 early in the second quarter) is from the AP and The Sporting Tribune; Detroit never led (IBTimes, and Covers lists its largest lead as 0). Bench points (45–67) are summed from the box score and match IBTimes. Luka Dončić sat out with lower-back tightness (AP). The Hawks' record and the Lakers' standing are from the site's standings.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Austin Reaves' off-balance three with 46 seconds left (the AP's description), which made it 112–104 (Lakers Daily) after the Lakers had led 109–104 (IBTimes). It came after Walker Kessler's three-point play had made it 107–99 with 2:15 left (AP). The recaps call the shot off-balance but don't describe how he got it, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Los Angeles Lakers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Reaves’ listed 6-foot-5 and 197 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-6¼ wingspan at the 2021 draft combine (Hoopsmatic), in the Lakers' road kit. His No. 15 is from team merchandise listings. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
